scope: Complete compare_artifacts CPU entry for bounded synthetic localized text changes; exact restoration and non-increasing final wire size; no model, token, cash, GPU, or end-to-end claim.

implementation.procedure: Independently inspect the public entry, changed helper, offsets, bounds and codec selection.
implementation.acceptance: Only proven-equal edges are excluded; offsets stay relative to the complete base; existing bounds and SHA reads remain.

reference_boundary.procedure: Use an independently written patch applicator over empty, CRLF, Unicode, insert, delete, repeated and randomized cases.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Every accepted packet reconstructs the exact target and preserves source identity.

data_integrity.procedure: Check fixed baseline/code/input hashes, seed, case counts and all seven paired samples.
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/duplicate cases or samples; recorded hashes match actual files and baseline.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians and reduction from finite nonnegative millisecond samples.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Reported values match raw pairs; no NaN, Inf, negative duration or unit mismatch.

measurement_validity.procedure: Run seven alternating-order paired calls after warmup through compare_artifacts including reads, hashes, selection and serialization.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Candidate median is at most half baseline and final wire size never exceeds baseline over at least 2,000 cases.

reproducibility.procedure: Run the frozen measurement command and focused artifact tests from a clean process.
reproducibility.acceptance: Measurement assertions and focused tests pass on the recorded CPU environment.
